invariants.rationale: A valid StorageConfiguration is required to create the writer.
A valid HoodieWriteConfig is required to configure the writer.
A non-null HoodieEngineContext is necessary for metadata operations.
The Option for the instant timestamp must be non-null (even if it may be Option.empty()).
If inflightInstantTimestamp is non-null and present, its value should not be null (Option contract).
